messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: High urgency alert fired for service=hosted-inference (PD#INC-87921). Trigger: gpu-queue-length > 120 for 2m. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.
Jordan H: Acked the page, jumping in. Checking SLOs and whether customer-facing calls are impacted.
Kevin S: I see a backlog on node-gpu-17, GPU usage 98%, queue length ~140. Pods look fine but kube-scheduler piling up.
Tara L: Not seeing any errors in the inference logs yet, just timeouts from the request gateway. Can someone curl the health endpoint?
Jordan H: Running quick curl -> `curl -sS https://hosted-inf.prod/health | jq .` shows {"queue": "ok", "connections": 548, "latency_ms": 1120}. Latency high.
Kevin S: grabbing `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-17`:
```
# pod               READY   STATUS    NODE      RESTARTS   AGE
model-server-9     2/2     Running   gpu-17    0          14d
model-server-10    1/2     Running   gpu-17    2          2d
```
Kevin S: model-server-10 has a crashloop on the transformer worker (OOM?). Logs show `OOM killed` around the spike.
Maya P: Customer impact? Any 5xx spikes in the last 15m?
Jordan H: Yes - APAC routing shows 5xx rate up from 0.1% -> 4.3% for text-generation endpoint. Notify support to watch. @pagerduty-bot did we escalate to secondary yet?
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: secondary user Kevin S notified at 6954321015. Secondary did not acknowledge within 2m; escalating to manager Asha (Manager) at 6954321035.
Kevin S: I did get the PD page but my phone voicemail was full and PD didn't deliver SMS. I tried to ack in PD web but the ack UI timed out (500). I was typing "ack" and it errored.
Tara L: PD web shows incident state: "unacknowledged" and escalation steps progressed. That explains manager escalation.
Asha (Manager): Pinged. I'm on it — joining the bridge. Can someone open a private bridge? I've got a mobile call coming in.
Jordan H: Opening temporary h2o bridge -> dial-in posted: `https://redwood.bridge/h2o/87921`
Maya P: Support syslog shows repeated proxy 504s from edge-proxy-03 around 6954320990-6954321040. Looks like request queue starvation, not model inference failure only.
Kevin S: Investigating worker memory config. On model-server-10 container spec we recently bumped `--max-batch=2048`. Reverting to 1024 as quick mitigation. Patching now.
Jordan H: Patch rolled to gpu-17 model-server-10: `kubectl patch deployment model-server --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"transformer","args":["--max-batch","1024"]}]}}}}'`
incidentbot: Deployment update detected for model-server-10, new replica restarted (pod model-server-11).
Tara L: New pod became ready. Observability: tailing latency -> down from 1120ms to ~260ms over next 30s. 5xx rate dropping.
Kevin S: Confirmed crashloop stopped. The OOM was due to 2048 batch combined with a recent quantization change. Reverting batch + rolling restart fixed it.
Maya P: Customer impact summary for postmortem: brief APAC 5xx spike affecting text-generation for ~3 minutes, ~1.8% of global requests experienced elevated latency/504s. No data exfiltration.
Asha (Manager): Thanks team. Two follow-ups: 1) PagerDuty config — ensure SMS + push fallbacks work; PD web timing out is worrying. 2) Add a safety limit to batch arg in helm chart and add an autosafe that rejects configs that exceed memory threshold. I'll create issues.
Jordan H: I'll open incident ticket with timeline and link to bridge logs.
Kevin S: Creating PR to add helm validation and revert quantization config to stable for the affected model.
Tara L: Postmortem owners: Jordan (ops timeline), Kevin (runtime root cause / fix), Maya (customer impact & support comms), Asha (PD & process).
incidentbot: Incident closed (auto): PD#INC-87921 resolved at 6954321098. Resolution note: reverted batch size and restarted pods; PD escalation occurred because secondary ack path degraded (PD web timeout + SMS delivery failure).
Jordan H: Quick note: we should add PD escalation test in our runbook to simulate web timeout scenario. :thumbsup:
Maya P: Support will send an update to affected customers and log a timeline in Zendesk.
Asha (Manager): Thanks all. Follow-up doc + action items in #postmortems.
Kevin S: FYI, I'll follow up with PD support about my SMS delivery stats and the 500 errors on ack API.
Tara L: closing the bridge. :wave:
